primary_quality_check.method: Primary read all original and revised claims, independently inspected sample complete source/build, complete compiled lambda and timed host interval, and all 2,853 final-SASS lines. Verified complementary short/long-row paths include every CSR interval each requested repetition, stream event ordering and result transfer complete before stop clock. Also inspected all ten main timed clock intervals and checked dispatcher boundaries against exact files; other nine full source/device inspections are Luna's with primary claims and provenance checks.
corrections: Versions1/2 truncated dispatch bodies and confused separately emitted wrappers with inline launch branches. Version3 includes complete actual timed dispatchers, including all sample lambda branches. Opus5 CC r4 timing wording is corrected: synchronization and output copy precede the end-clock call. No work-count finding changed.
